title: Flaky tests: causes, diagnosis and quarantine

videos.script: A flaky test passes, then fails, then passes again, on the same code. {{gate}} This lesson starts with your own suite. Run it ten times, and one test fails in five of the runs and passes in the other five. Same tests, same shop, nothing edited. {{cost}} That is worse than a test that always fails. A red that goes away on a second run teaches people to press the button again. And one day the red is real. {{causes}} Flakiness has causes, and this lesson names six. Each one comes with a case from the shop, and one from the platform you are studying on. {{repeat}} Then you diagnose one. You run it twenty times, count the failures, and change one thing at a time. {{race}} You see two runs of the same test side by side. Six answers land within eight milliseconds, and the last one decides the verdict. {{retries}} You try retries, and see what they hide. {{quarantine}} You move the test out of the gate without deleting it, with an owner and a date. {{fix}} And you fix it where it starts, which is almost never a longer timeout. {{end}}
